channel.title: Rambam's Introduction to Helek — Dayan Daniel Kada
channel.description: Dayan Daniel Kada's series on the Rambam's Introduction to Perek Helek: the World to Come, reward and punishment, and the Thirteen Principles of Faith.
channel.itunes:author: Dayan Daniel Kada

item.title: What Is the Ultimate Reward? | Rambam's Introduction to Helek, Part 1
item.description:
Gan Eden, Mashiah, resurrection, this world: is any of them the ultimate reward? Opening the Rambam's introduction to Perek Helek: the Mishnah's list of those who lose their share, why all five mistaken views are physical, and the parable of the child on serving from love.

item.description:
Can a physical being grasp Olam HaBa? The Rambam's three readings of aggadah, literal, dismissive and deeper, why the physical cannot perceive it, like the blind with colours, and the crowns and radiance of the Shekhinah as the enduring, knowing soul.

item.title: The Other Kinds of Reward: Blessings & Curses | Rambam's Introduction to Helek, Part 3
item.description:
If Olam HaBa is the reward, what are the Torah's blessings and curses? The Rambam reads them as removing or imposing obstacles to serving HaShem, and places Gan Eden and Gehinom as real but not principles of faith, unlike resurrection and Mashiah.
